_readme: Safety facts Landfall checks. Loaded into the hub with query I11 after the Scout has written the molecule and its applications.

A fact is a labeling change FDA approved on one or more reference applications, plus the section code and the short heading (phrase key) whose presence proves the change landed on a label. The phrase key is a 3-5 word heading, never label text.
status: ACTIVE facts produce verdicts. UNVERIFIED facts produce none until a pharmacist verifies them (P2, FLOWS F16). verified_note records who on the team checked the source before the event.
issued_d is days since 1970-01-01 (UTC). issued is the Drugs@FDA submission_status_date of the labeling supplement.

facts.title: Boxed warning: serious neuropsychiatric events (montelukast)
facts.verified_note: FDA Drug Safety Communication dated 2020-03-04 (found by web search 18 Oct 2026). Drugs@FDA submissions checked 18 Oct 2026 (class LABELING, status AP, 2020-04-29 on all three); reference label carries a coded 34066-1 section from Organon set 482dcc92 v1 onward. A team pharmacist-equivalent re-verifies at G027.

facts.title: Boxed warning: complex sleep behaviors (zolpidem)
facts.verified_note: Drugs@FDA: NDA019908 (AMBIEN, holder COSETTE) S-046 and NDA021774 (AMBIEN CR) S-027 approved 2019-08-18, class LABELING. Ambien SPL v16 (Feb 2019) has no boxed warning; v17 (published 2019-09-03) has a coded 34066-1 section with the phrase. Other zolpidem reference products (Edluar, Intermezzo, Zolpimist) are not yet listed: add them at verification time. Source URL found by web search on 18 Oct 2026 (FDA safety alert page; the Drug Safety Communication itself is mirrored on cacmap.fda.gov); the verifying pharmacist opens and confirms it.
